points.description: Justification states that the pipe is unidirectional (one-directional): data flows one way only, so reading from fd[1] / writing to fd[0] is not possible.
Justification states precisely that fd[0] is the read end and only reads can be done from fd[0].
Justification states precisely that fd[1] is the write end and only writes can be done at fd[1].

rubric.notes: Full marks need TRUE plus a justification that names the pipe as one-directional and gives both roles precisely: fd[0] is read-only and fd[1] is write-only. If TRUE has no correct justification, give 0 overall. Part marks only for a point that is clearly more than half stated precisely. Any wrong statement, such as reversed roles or calling the pipe bidirectional, loses that point. Vague or implied statements earn nothing.
